subject: Speed up unsigned branchfull divider
perf_evidence: Commit removes redundant shift masks from unsigned branchfull scalar and SIMD division paths.
change_summary: Uses the generated shift field directly for unsigned-32/64 branchfull scalar, SSE2, AVX2 and AVX512 division.

units.name: public generated unsigned-32/64 scalar division
units.evidence: Both scalar generated-divider API targets pass Alive2 in both directions.

units.name: public generated unsigned-32/64 SSE2 vector division
units.evidence: Both SSE2 generated-divider API targets pass bidirectional Alive2.

units.name: public generated unsigned-32/64 AVX2 vector division
units.evidence: Unsigned-32 passes in the avx2 run; the previously timed-out unsigned-64 target passes both directions in the long AVX2 run.

units.name: public generated unsigned-32/64 AVX512 vector division
units.evidence: Unsigned-32 passes in the avx512 run; the previously timed-out unsigned-64 target passes both directions in the long AVX512 run.

units.name: raw division with arbitrary magic/more fields
units.evidence: Alive2 gives raw scalar counterexamples when more contains bits that a generated divider never stores; corresponding SIMD raw targets also differ.

notes: The helper-level difference concerns arbitrary fabricated divider fields; the generated-divider public scalar and three SIMD variants all have bidirectional proof. The wrapper disables unchanged x86 generator assembly on both sides.
